title: German Vegan Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with traditional German flavors and plant-based ingredients.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add sliced onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add diced carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in canned tomatoes and apple cider vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
